description: This Python source file defines a MarkdownTextFilter class that converts Markdown content to plain text by removing or transforming Markdown syntax, handling code blocks, tables, HTML tags, and entities. It includes configuration options for filtering code blocks and tables, and methods for updating settings, filtering text, and handling interruptions.

classes.name: MarkdownTextFilter
classes.description: A text filter class that removes or transforms Markdown formatting into plain text, with configurable options for filtering code blocks and tables.

classes.name: MarkdownTextFilter.InputParams
classes.description: A Pydantic model class defining configuration parameters for the MarkdownTextFilter, including enable_text_filter, filter_code, and filter_tables.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the MarkdownTextFilter with optional configuration parameters and sets internal state flags.

methods.name: update_settings
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the filter's configuration settings based on a provided mapping.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Asynchronously applies Markdown filtering transformations to input text, removing or converting Markdown syntax.

methods.name: handle_interruption
methods.description: Handles interruption events by resetting internal state flags related to code blocks and tables.

methods.name: reset_interruption
methods.description: Resets the interruption flag to resume normal operation.

methods.name: _remove_code_blocks
methods.description: Removes code blocks from the input text, handling interruption states.

methods.name: _handle_in_code_block
methods.description: Handles text when inside a code block, removing content until the end of the code block.

methods.name: _handle_not_in_code_block
methods.description: Handles text when not currently inside a code block, detecting start of code blocks.

methods.name: _handle_start_of_code_block
methods.description: Handles the start of a code block, setting state and returning text before the code block.

methods.name: _handle_code_block_within_text
methods.description: Handles code blocks found within text, removing or skipping content accordingly.

methods.name: remove_tables
methods.description: Removes HTML table tags and content from the input text, handling partial and complete tables.
